collection.description: A coconut is balanced on top of a villager's roof, and nobody knows how it got there.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There is a coconut on (subject)'s roof. Right on the top, balanced in the thatch. The nearest palm tree is a good twenty paces away. It didn't fall there. Nobody seems to have put it there. It's just sitting there, perfectly round, like it's always meant to be there.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) climbs up and fetches it down. It's a perfectly ordinary coconut. (subject.He/She) cracks it open for lunch, and it's delicious. The next morning, there is another coconut on (subject.his/her) roof. (subject) stands looking up at it for a long time. Then (subject.he/she) leaves this one where it is, out of respect.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) asks everyone. Nobody put it there. (child), a child, suggests a very strong bird. (elder), an elder, suggests a very bored spirit. (friend) suggests a very good throw from someone who doesn't want to own up. (subject) can't decide which is most likely. The coconut stays on the roof for a week, and becomes, somehow, a sort of mascot.
